subject: Private deployment workshop — on-prem/VPC review
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sylvia Lam <sylvia.lam@blueridgebio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Private deployment workshop — on-prem/VPC review

Hi Sylvia,

Great to speak earlier — thanks for walking through BlueRidge's goals and constraints. Quick recap and a proposal for next steps so we can get your infra team hands-on: 

- Scope: private deployment (VPC + on-prem integration), network egress controls, KMS/HSM integration, and onboarding checklist.
- Outcome: 90-minute technical workshop with our solutions engineers to review the proposed network diagram, risk checklist, and integration plan.

Can you confirm who from your side should attend (network, security, cloud infra)? I recommend including someone who manages the on-prem firewalls and the person who owns KMS.

Proposed 90-minute slots (PT):
1) Wed, Dec 2 — 10:00–11:30 AM PT
2) Wed, Dec 2 — 2:00–3:30 PM PT
3) Thu, Dec 3 — 9:00–10:30 AM PT

Or pick a time here: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/private-onprem-workshop

Attached is a short on-prem checklist that helps speed the call (network ports, proxy, certs). If you can share a simple network diagram (PDF or PNG) ahead of time that would help us tailor the runbook discussion.

Attachments: [Attachment: onprem-checklist.pdf (450KB)]

Thanks — looking forward to coordinating.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
tessa_morgan@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
https://redwood.com
From: Sylvia Lam <sylvia.lam@blueridgebio.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: it_ops@blueridgebio.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment workshop — on-prem/VPC review

Tessa — thanks, that summary is perfect.

We can do option (1) on Dec 2 at 10:00 AM PT. Attendees from our side: Marcus Yeo (network lead) and the IT operations mailbox (it_ops@blueridgebio.com). Marcus will try to send a one-page network diagram before the call.

Couple of asks from our security team in advance:
- Can you include a short list of the SOC2 artifacts you typically request for Private deployments?
- We need a quick note on whether Redwood supports customer-managed HSMs for key wrapping (high level).

I see the checklist attachment — helpful. We’ll upload the diagram when Marcus has it. Please send a calendar invite and any dial-in details.

Thanks,
Sylvia Lam
Director, IT Security
BlueRidge Biotech

Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private deployment workshop — on-prem/VPC review

Perfect — thanks Sylvia, we’ll lock in Wed Dec 2 at 10:00 AM PT. I’ll send the calendar invite in a minute. 

Marissa / Karthik — looping you in to prep the workshop. Notes and prework: 
- Primary goals: review Marcus's network diagram, validate firewall/NAT rules for egress, walk through KMS options (customer-managed HSM vs Redwood-managed KMS), and confirm audit/logging story + retention.
- Deliverable: short action list at the end of the workshop with owners and a proposed timeline for on-prem networking changes.
- Pre-read: onprem-checklist.pdf (attached) and our internal runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/ENG/On-Prem+Deployment+Runbook

Marissa: can you own the run-through for observability (what telemetry we require, token scoping)?
Karthik: please prepare a one-slide summary on supported HSM/KMS integrations and any limitations for VPC peering/NAT.

I’ve attached a lightweight network diagram stub you can edit for the call.

Attachments: [Attachment: network-diagram-stub.png (120KB)]

Thanks — I’ll add the calendar invite (Google Meet) and include the dial-in and agenda.

Best,
Tessa

Thanks — invite received and accepted. Marcus and I will join from the office; attaching the one-page diagram for your team.

A couple quick clarifications before we start:
- SOC2 artifacts: a short checklist would be ideal (controls we can expect to exchange or evidence we need to produce).
- HSM: managed by Redwood is fine for now, but we need the option to key-wrap with a customer HSM in the future; please flag any timeline/constraints.

Attachment: [Attachment: blueridge-network-1page.pdf (230KB)]

See you at 10:00 AM PT.

Best,
Sylvia
